scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 8 boards of two live Deity Online Kristina (Sweden) Culture games armed with culture-faith-site-per-theater-2 (212836Z t84-t112, 210516Z t90/t100), turns whose why.log journalled a Theater city 'not safe' with no major war on; each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch at 6e9a131430 with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with culture-faith-braves-the-barbarians. Two boards of 220038Z were also queried but could not run (its summary.json carries no forced list); summary.json in the archive still counts them. Orders differ on 2/8: 212836Z t90 the on arm starts Jönköping's Holy Site and t96 Stockholm's, where the off arm's claim stopped at a Barbarian Line Infantry or Musketman within six tiles. The other boards show the next limits in the on arm's skip journal (Theater Square, Builder, Amphitheater, Art Museum and Settler heads; no free district slot).
